claims.text: This excerpt shows a series of system log events on two devices, calvisitor-10-105-160-95 and authorMacBook-Pro, occurring over a period of a few minutes.

The events include changes in thermal and memory pressure states, deallocation of a task, and adjustments to wireless networking and power settings, indicating normal system activity and potential preparation for sleep mode.
The logs also suggest a transition from sleep to wake on one of the devices, authorMacBook-Pro, due to a wake on scan offload event.
